propositions: The close precheck scans historical commit messages and calls the shared resolver for every extracted reference, causing unrelated ambiguous-prefix errors to print to stderr even though the precheck only needs to validate against accepted target IDs.

The close precheck successfully closes the target ticket despite printing ambiguity diagnostics from unrelated historical references, indicating the errors are pure diagnostic noise with no impact on gate semantics.
The fix adds a quiet keyword-only parameter to resolve_ticket_id that gates the three stderr ambiguity diagnostic prints, passed as quiet=True only from _referencing_commit_exists scan loop.
User-supplied ambiguous prefix resolution in explicit commands retains full diagnostics because those code paths do not pass quiet=True.
